_comment: Vigil-recommended force-install extension policy. Roadmap X3.
_usage: Drop this file (or its contents) under Chromium's `policies/managed/` JSON-policy directory on Windows, or load via the ADMX template at admx/vigil.admx. The bundled uBlock Origin, NTP, and command palette extensions are staged from verified local archives/pointers; this policy does not depend on a Chrome Web Store update URL.

_optional_clinic_addons_commented_out._doc: Common additions sysadmins enable in clinic/enterprise deployments. Uncomment in your local copy.
_examples: // I Still Don't Care About Cookies: edibdbjcniadpccecjdfdjjppcpchdlm

*._comment: Per-extension defaults. blocked_install_message is shown when a user tries to install something policy-blocked.
*.blocked_install_message: Extension installs are restricted by your Vigil deployment policy. Contact your administrator if you need an exception.

cjpalhdlnbpafiamejdnhcphjbkeiagm._comment: uBlock Origin is installed from the verified default_extensions pointer; deployments needing managed force-install should provide a separately reviewed internal CRX/update endpoint. Vigil never points this policy at the Chrome Web Store.
